correctness.rationale: Explicit Hilbert vector factorization plus real orthogonal witness gives equality of real/complex norm and normalized trace. The tensor eigenbasis computes all q-ary Hamming eigenvalues with multiplicities. The binomial mean-deviation identity telescopes exactly; cell derivative and boundary tie prove strict q-monotonicity; Poisson adjacent masses tie at integral limits; local CLT yields fixed-q asymptotic. Standalone standard-library integer/rational checker verified 3392 parameter identities, 3328 strict comparisons and 346 independently constructed tensor eigenmodes. Finite arithmetic is corroboration only.

value.rationale: A full exact operator norm across a natural doubly indexed family, rather than a generic matrix bound; sharp strict alphabet monotonicity and nonattained supremum despite vanishing negative-sign density; two complementary Gaussian/Poisson regimes, with infinitely many explicit Poisson parameter cusps.
